author: GlamVampira
quote: The least GTA game of all GTAs. The missions are really underwhelming, everything feels like a chore and there is such a huge lack of freedom. The npcs aren't as funny as before, as lively as the world is, what's the poin if the NPCs are so boring? The characters are not charming in the slightest, I really don't care about 95% of them. I was excited to have a female protagonist, but Lucia seems like she was made solely for fanservice. Jason couldn't be more bland, no emotion in his voice whatsoever. Everything good there is to this game are the graphics and the songs, but the songs aren't even theirs! Buggy 30fps mess, good lord, this game needed even more time! Also, the endings are SO underwhelming, even a kid could write something more impactful than that!

author: GlamVampira
quote: Everything about this game is just so good to me! I love how balanced the horror and action aspects are, and the story does not disappoint. The chracaters are charming and the designs are really memorable. The sound design suits the atmosphere perfectly, and the performances of the VAs are jaw dropping! Truly a work of art.

author: GlamVampira
quote: Buggy, glitchy mess at it's core. Poppy Playtime started out with so much potential, and yet the devs just threw it out the window. The story is pure slop, introducing new, useless characters just to make more merch for the stupid kids that adore this game. Truly a waste of time and money, would not recommend

author: GlamVampira
quote: I am at a loss for words, I have never seen a game that looked so whimsical and yet so immersive before. You can't go wrong with Zelda, it's a masterpiece. The visuals, the ost, the puzzles, the exploration, it's all a 10/10. The missions are really fun, the fights are really engaging, the designs are top notch, It truly deserves the praise!!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
